name: LlamaFirewall
summary: Meta's open-source guardrail framework for agents that chains scanners for prompt injection, goal hijacking and insecure generated code.
description: Scanners: PromptGuard 2 (jailbreak/injection classifier), AlignmentCheck (chain-of-thought audit for goal hijacking and indirect injection), regex/custom LLM scanners, and CodeShield (Semgrep and regex rules across 8 languages). `pip install llamafirewall` (PyPI 1.0.3, May 2025; Python 3.10+); some scanners need access to gated Llama models on Hugging Face. MIT per LlamaFirewall/LICENSE. Known issue (checked 2026-11-04): with huggingface_hub 1.x or later, importing the PromptGuard scanner from PyPI 1.0.3 fails with “cannot import name 'HfFolder'”. Commit 9a3d175 (2026-03-26) fixed promptguard_utils.py on main but is unreleased, and cli/configure.py on main still imports HfFolder, so `llamafirewall configure` still breaks. Workaround: pip install "huggingface_hub<1.0" "transformers<5".
